page.overview:
Who is Gromek?

Vice Admiral Gromek was a female Human 24th century Starfleet flag officer.

In 2365, Gromek contacted the with "top secret" orders to intercept a class 8 probe which contained Klingon special emissary K'Ehleyr. ()
